items.text: We're thrilled to announce the release of a major update for Retro Drive Revamped, bringing exciting new features, improvements, and content to enhance your retro racing experience. Here's what's new:

Tapes Placement Fix: We've heard your feedback loud and clear - tapes should be a reward, not a punishment! With this update, tapes are now properly placed on the screen, ensuring a fair and enjoyable challenge for all retro racers.

Save System Enhancement: We've thoroughly checked and improved the save system to ensure its viability for seamless future content additions. Your progress is now in safe hands, ready for new adventures on the horizon.

Audio Pitch Issue Resolved: No more unexpected pitch changes! Going from level 9 to level 1 will no longer cause audio issues. Say goodbye to pitch shifts during game over incidents like hitting a camper van.
City Level Stuck Fix: Getting stuck facing up in the city level is now a thing of the past. Glide through the cityscapes smoothly and without any unexpected roadblocks.

Crisp Pixel Art in Credits: We've sharpened up the pixel art in the credits, ensuring a clearer and more visually pleasing acknowledgment of the talented individuals who contributed to Retro Drive Revamped.
AICar_Red (7) Correction: The notorious red car at the start of level 8 has been tamed. Prepare for a fairer race without any unexpected challenges from this particular rival.
Map Menu Music Fix: Levels now have the music they deserve! The map menu is no longer silent - enjoy the soundtrack as you navigate through the different levels.

Oil Slick Balance Adjusted: Oil slicks are now more balanced, offering a challenging yet fair obstacle for players. Navigate the tracks with precision and skill without the frustration of unbalanced gameplay.
Japanese Font: Our Japanese font has passed the test! Retro Drive Revamped is now even more accessible to our Japanese players, ensuring a smooth reading experience.
Multilingual Tips: Tips are now localized, providing helpful advice to all players, regardless of language preference. Get ready to race with confidence, no matter where you're from.
Thank you for your patience and valuable feedback. We're committed to delivering an optimal racing experience, and we can't wait to see you on the improved tracks!
